incidents.issue: Copied inventory report retained eight machine-local links rejected by public-clone link contract
incidents.resolution: Portable relative links in copied report only; original bytes retained as precheck/REPORT.original.txt; no frozen specification or input hashes changed.

style_note: git diff --cached --check returned 2 solely for a trailing blank line in the already hash-frozen specification. Its bytes were preserved; the per-command whitespace check disables only blank-at-eof.

_public_projection.meaning: Paths sanitized; hashes and exit codes describe the preserved original execution, not a rerun.
